rules: Canonical storage remains watch occurrences/evidence. No model answer is a fact.
ResearchScope is server bound, authorized profile version and live/controlled namespace. Model tools take no company/profile/URL arguments.
Scope generation changes for a changed source set/hash or changed result state, not identical recollection. Missing lookup generation0 is guarded too.
ResearchPort.lookup before refresh. refresh rechecks in durable storage; reusable/fresh returns without collector call.
Durable intent before external call; interrupted attempt is uncertain and never automatically retried.
ResearchContext max10 observations, bounded contents, source_observation_only. testOnly matches namespace and mode:test; live requires mode:direct.

Agent records and validates exact refs plus generation/freshness before and after provider/tools; refreshed generation returns stale_context and a new run. Never retain old evaluations under a new token.
No research proposal: existing needs_input plus explicit researchResult outcome available identifies successful retrieval without a business proposal. UI must label this object correctly.
All dependencies imposed from server scope plus returned lookups, persisted before publish and rechecked under company lock at publication/approval.
Controlled source ingestion is an operator-only explicit test path. Do not relax public direct-only case evidence.
R2 tests demonstrate source-change staleness, not an already-existing relation rejection. Historical proof and plans preserved.
